name: The Serious Feline Masterchef
visual_dna: Serious, deadpan domestic short-hair cat wearing a miniature pleated white chef hat and red neckerchief
High-contrast, cinematic kitchen setting with polished steel counters and warm ambient backlighting
Extreme slow-motion disaster sequence with exaggerated close-ups of spills, burning, or slipping ingredients
Instant hard whip-cut to clean, methodical preparation performed perfectly by the cat
Crash-zoom or punchy slow push-in onto the cat's completely unbothered, stoic face staring directly into the lens
character_sheet_prompt: A character sheet of an intense tabby cat with bright amber eyes wearing a tiny crisp white chef hat and miniature red kitchen necktie, vertical 9:16 layout, multiple angles including stoic front portrait, side profile with serious expression, and paws posed over a cutting board, professional studio food photography lighting, hyper-realistic, photorealistic fur texture
audio_vibe: Graver-than-life documentary narrator with deep resonant tone, sudden vinyl scratch or sub-bass drop on the hard cut, transitioning to sophisticated, uptempo classical acoustic bass and light ticking percussion
hook_formula: Extreme close-up 120fps slow-motion failure (smoke, spill, dropped tool) paired with an absurdly grandiose dramatic voiceover in the first 1.5 seconds
reusable_broll_prompts: A vertical 9:16 loopable shot of a calm domestic cat in a tiny chef hat sitting upright behind a stainless steel prep station, slow steady camera breathe, warm culinary lighting
A vertical 9:16 loop of sizzling golden garlic and herbs in clear olive oil inside a black cast-iron pan, macro shot, gentle steam rising, soft cinematic bokeh
A vertical 9:16 slow push-in toward a stoic cat face staring deadpan into camera while wearing a small chef hat, kitchen background softly blurred
retention_psychology: Cognitive contrast and humor incongruity: the stark disparity between a chaotic technical disaster and an impeccably calm animal authority figure resets attention, while the micro-pacing shift delivers rapid dopamine payoff.
teaching_fit: Common mistake vs industry standard correct execution
Debugging broken code or malfunctioning technical systems
Proper workplace tool handling vs dangerous shortcuts
safety_notes: Do not depict real animals in contact with actual open flame or dangerous kitchen cutlery
Ensure the cat model is generic and does not resemble copyrighted meme cats or branded mascots
Avoid showing toxic foods (e.g., onions, garlic, chocolate) consumed by the cat character
